crossRefs.note: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many; but a prince will cause the reproach offered by…

translations.web: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
translations.bsb: When you walk, they will guide you; when you lie down, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.
translations.kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk
translations.asv: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
